title: Fix a bug in a JavaScript module
prompt: Customers say the cart total is wrong when a discount code is used. The tests in test/ show it. Fix cart.js so `node --test` passes, without changing the tests.
notes: The visible tests must come back exactly as they were (the prompt says not to change them): an agent that deletes or weakens one fails the file check. Hidden tests (grader/, copied in after the run) cover other carts and an unknown code.
